summary.text: J.C. Windmueller is the Libertarian candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 100 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 2 Libertarian primary.
He was also the Libertarian candidate for Montana House District 95 in 2022, finishing third in the general election.
